text: Add standing defaults that the reading step applies without asking the user, unless the request says otherwise. (1) The outcome is the check behind the work, not the activity done. For audience-facing quality, a fresh model reader that took no part in the work rates the live result as a newcomer, and a rating below 4 of 5 blocks completion. (2) An empty queue or finished list never counts as success on its own. (3) If the same item fails twice in a loop, the loop stops and reports thrashing. Record these defaults as acceptance criteria in the reading. Show that a request for an explainer page gets them with no question to the user.
